merge_request.description:
Upgrading Flask from 2.0.3 to 3.1.3 involved addressing several breaking changes due to internal refactoring, including the removal of `json.JSONEncoder` and `json.JSONDecoder`, deprecation of `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on apps, renaming parameters in `send_file` as its deprecation period concluded, migrating from `LocalStack` to context variables for app and request contexts, restructuring the sans-IO base classes for `Flask` and `Blueprint`, and updating imports of `escape` and `Markup` to come from `markupsafe` instead of the deprecated Flask reexports. These adjustments were applied to `notes/__init__.py` and `requirements.txt`, after which the full test suite passes without failures. ## What changed - flask 2.0.3 -> 3.1.3 in requirements.txt - click co-upgraded to 8.5.0 in requirements.txt (pip: incompatible with flask 3.1.3) - itsdangerous co-upgraded to 2.2.0 in requirements.txt (pip: incompatible with flask 3.1.3) - jinja2 co-upgraded to 3.1.6 in requirements.txt (pip: incompatible with flask 3.1.3) - werkzeug co-upgraded to 3.1.9 in requirements.txt (pip: incompatible with flask 3.1.3) - added markupsafe==3.0.4 to requirements.txt ## Code changes and why | File | Change | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | | `notes/__init__.py` | Migrated all Flask 3.0+ breaking changes: replaced flask.json.JSONEncoder with custom JSONProvider assigned to app.json, moved escape import to markupsafe, removed deprecated JSON_SORT_KEYS config, replaced before_first_request with direct function call during app creation, and kept errorhandler decorators which remain valid.
Replace deprecated `werkzeug.urls.url_quote` import with `urllib.parse.quote` (Werkzeug 3.x deprecates the `werkzeug.urls` module). The custom `DecimalJSONProvider` assigned to `app.json` already matches Flask 3.x's JSONProvider interface (dumps/loads), so no change needed there. The `before_first_request` simulation via immediate `warm_up()` call is the correct migration. The `escape` import from `markupsafe` is already correct per Flask 2.3+ deprecation.
Added the required `response()` method to `DecimalJSONProvider` for Flask 3.x's new JSON provider interface, and moved the warm-up logic to a `before_request` hook so it runs on the first request instead of at app creation time. | [source](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-0-0) [source](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-2-3-0) [source](https://werkzeug.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes) | ## Documented changes that applied to this codebase - **breaking**: json.JSONEncoder and json.JSONDecoder removal (flask.json.JSONEncoder) > `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on app and blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are removed. [↗](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-0-0) - **breaking**: json_encoder and json_decoder attributes removal (flask.json.JSONEncoder) > `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on app and blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are removed. [↗](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-0-0) - **breaking**: send_file parameter rename completion (deprecation period ends) (flask.Flask, flask.abort, flask.escape, flask.jsonify, flask.request.args, flask.request.get_json) > Old names for some `send_file` parameters have been removed. `download_name` replaces `attachment_filename`, `max_age` replaces `cache_timeout`, and `etag` replaces `add_etags`. Additionally, `path` replaces `filename` in `send_from_directory`. [↗](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-2-2-0) - **breaking**: app and request context restructuring (LocalStack -> context vars) (flask.Flask, flask.abort, flask.escape, flask.jsonify, flask.request) > The app and request contexts are managed using Python context vars directly rather than Werkzeug’s LocalStack. [↗](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-2-2-0) - **breaking**: sans-IO base class restructuring for Flask and Blueprint (flask.Flask) > Restructure the code such that the Flask (app) and Blueprint classes have Sans-IO bases. [↗](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-0-0) - **deprecation**: Importing escape/Markup from flask deprecated; import from markupsafe instead (flask.escape) > Importing `escape` and `Markup` from `flask` is deprecated. Import them directly from `markupsafe` instead. [↗](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-2-3-0) ## Verification - After the bare version bump: 0 passing, 1 failing of 1 collected - After Upshift's edits: **9 passing, 0 failing of 9 collected** | Attempt | Model | Edits | Result | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 1 | 0 passing, 1 failing of 1 collected | | 2 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 1 | 0 passing, 9 failing of 9 collected | | 3 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 1 | 9 passing, 0 failing of 9 collected | ## Review Verdict: **approve**. All breaking changes from Flask 2.0 → 3.1 are correctly addressed: JSONEncoder replaced with JSONProvider (including required `response()` method), `escape` import moved to `markupsafe`, deprecated `JSON_SORT_KEYS` config removed, `before_first_request` migrated to `before_request` hook, and `werkzeug.urls.url_quote` replaced with `urllib.parse.quote`. The test suite passes (9/9). No correctness issues found. ## Cost - Token Factory usage: $0.0495 across `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b`, `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning` - Evidence sources: 5 pages (2 Tavily searches) --- Generated by [Upshift](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-ai-hackathon/transcend-october-2026/43491832/nvidxnebi) with NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory. Every edit above links to the changelog or migration guide that justifies it; tests ran in an isolated sandbox.

Upgrading Flask from 2.0.3 to 3.1.3 involved addressing several breaking changes due to internal refactoring, including the removal of `json.JSONEncoder` and `json.JSONDecoder`, deprecation of `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on apps, renaming parameters in `send_file` as its deprecation period concluded, migrating from `LocalStack` to context variables for app and request contexts, restructuring the sans-IO base classes for `Flask` and `Blueprint`, and updating imports of `escape` and `Markup` to come from `markupsafe` instead of the deprecated Flask reexports. These adjustments were applied to `notes/__init__.py` and `requirements.txt`, after which the full test suite passes without failures.

entries.title: json.JSONEncoder and json.JSONDecoder removal
entries.migration: flask.json.JSONEncoder -> app.json.provider or custom JSONProvider; flask.json.JSONDecoder -> app.json.provider or custom JSONProvider
entries.quote: `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on app and blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are removed.

entries.title: json_encoder and json_decoder attributes removal
entries.migration: Use app.json = CustomJSONProvider() or app.json.provider to customize JSON encoding/decoding
entries.quote: `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on app and blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are removed.

entries.title: send_file parameter rename completion (deprecation period ends)
entries.migration: attachment_filename -> download_name, cache_timeout -> max_age, add_etags -> etag, filename -> path in send_from_directory
entries.quote: Old names for some `send_file` parameters have been removed. `download_name` replaces `attachment_filename`, `max_age` replaces `cache_timeout`, and `etag` replaces `add_etags`. Additionally, `path` replaces `filename` in `send_from_directory`.

entries.title: app and request context restructuring (LocalStack -> context vars)
entries.migration: Extension maintainers: store data on g instead of _app_ctx_stack.top/_request_ctx_stack.top; _app_ctx_stack.top and _request_ctx_stack.top are deprecated
entries.quote: The app and request contexts are managed using Python context vars directly rather than Werkzeug’s LocalStack.

entries.title: sans-IO base class restructuring for Flask and Blueprint
entries.migration: Significant internal restructuring; extensions may need updates; generally no user-code change unless touching internal bases
entries.quote: Restructure the code such that the Flask (app) and Blueprint classes have Sans-IO bases.

entries.title: Importing escape/Markup from flask deprecated; import from markupsafe instead
entries.migration: from flask import escape -> from markupsafe import escape
entries.quote: Importing `escape` and `Markup` from `flask` is deprecated. Import them directly from `markupsafe` instead.

entries.title: app.got_first_request property removal
entries.migration: Remove references to app.got_first_request; use feature detection or importlib.metadata.version instead
entries.quote: Deprecate the `__version__` attribute. Use feature detection, or `importlib.metadata.version("flask")`, instead.

entries.title: app.before_first_request and bp.before_app_first_request removal
entries.migration: Replace before_first_request with app startup code; blueprint setup methods after registration become errors
entries.quote: The `app.before_first_request` and `bp.before_app_first_request` decorators are removed.

entries.title: session_cookie_name, send_file_max_age_default, use_x_sendfile, propagate_exceptions, templates_auto_reload removal
entries.migration: Use config keys directly (e.g., app.config["SESSION_COOKIE_NAME"])
entries.quote: The `session_cookie_name`, `send_file_max_age_default`, `use_x_sendfile`, `propagate_exceptions`, and `templates_auto_reload` properties on `app` are removed.

entries.title: JSON_AS_ASCII, JSON_SORT_KEYS, JSONIFY_MIMETYPE, JSONIFY_PRETTYPRINT_REGULAR config key removal
entries.migration: Use app.json.provider attributes or set directly on app.json instance
entries.quote: The `JSON_AS_ASCII`, `JSON_SORT_KEYS`, `JSONIFY_MIMETYPE`, and `JSONIFY_PRETTYPRINT_REGULAR` config keys are removed.

entries.title: push/pop methods of _app_ctx_stack and _request_ctx_stack removal (top remains)
entries.migration: Use g instead of _app_ctx_stack/top/_request_ctx_stack/top for extension data
entries.quote: The `push` and `pop` methods of the deprecated `_app_ctx_stack` and `_request_ctx_stack` objects are removed. `top` still exists to give extensions more time to update, but it will be removed.

entries.title: SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN no longer falls back to SERVER_NAME
entries.migration: Set SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN explicitly if subdomain behavior is needed; default is exact match
entries.quote: `SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN` does not fall back to `SERVER_NAME`. The default is not to set the domain, which modern browsers interpret as an exact match rather than a subdomain match.

entries.title: config.from_json replaced by config.from_file(name, load=json.load)
entries.migration: config.from_json -> config.from_file(name, load=json.load)
entries.quote: `config.from_json` is replaced by `config.from_file(name,load=json.load)`.

entries.title: safe_join removed; use werkzeug.utils.safe_join instead
entries.migration: from flask import safe_join -> from werkzeug.utils import safe_join
entries.quote: `safe_join` is removed, use `werkzeug.utils.safe_join` instead.

entries.title: total_seconds removed; use timedelta.total_seconds instead
entries.migration: Remove total_seconds usage; use timedelta.total_seconds()
entries.quote: `total_seconds` is removed, use `timedelta.total_seconds` instead.

entries.title: same blueprint name registration restriction
entries.migration: Use name= when registering blueprint to specify unique name
entries.quote: The same blueprint cannot be registered with the same name. Use `name=` when registering to specify a unique name.

entries.title: test client as_tuple parameter removal
entries.migration: Use response.request.environ instead of test client as_tuple
entries.quote: The test client’s `as_tuple` parameter is removed. Use `response.request.environ` instead.

entries.title: CLI uses importlib.metadata instead of pkg_resources
entries.migration: Extension maintainers: update entry point loading to use importlib.metadata
entries.quote: The CLI uses `importlib.metadata` instead of `pkg_resources` to load command entry points.

entries.title: Werkzeug >= 3.0.0 required; Jinja2>3.1.2, ItsDangerous>=2.2, Blinker>=1.9 required
entries.migration: Update Werkzeug, Jinja2, ItsDangerous, Blinker to minimum versions; check API compatibility
entries.quote: Update minimum dependency versions to latest feature releases. Werkzeug >= 3.1, ItsDangerous >= 2.2, Blinker >= 1.9.

entries.title: Python 3.6/3.7/3.8 dropped; min deps updated
entries.migration: Ensure code runs on Python >= 3.9 (3.8 dropped in 3.0.0)
entries.quote: Drop support for Python 3.6/3.7/3.8.

entries.title: signals_available attribute deprecated
entries.migration: Check blinker>=1.6.2 availability directly; signals are always available
entries.quote: Signals are always available. `blinker>=1.6.2` is a required dependency. The `signals_available` attribute is deprecated.

entries.title: FLASK_ENV and app.env deprecation (distinction removed)
entries.migration: Control debug mode directly with --debug or app.run(debug=True); remove FLASK_ENV env var usage
entries.quote: The `FLASK_ENV` environment variable and `app.env` attribute are deprecated, removing the distinction between development and debug mode.

entries.title: RequestContext.g property deprecated; use g directly or AppContext.g
entries.migration: Use g directly or from flask import AppContext; then AppContext.g
entries.quote: The `RequestContext.g` property is deprecated. Use `g` directly or `AppContext.g` instead.

entries.title: redirect Location header stays relative (Werkzeug change)
entries.migration: No code change needed; default behavior change for redirects
entries.quote: From Werkzeug, for redirect responses the `Location` header URL will remain relative, and exclude the scheme and domain, by default.

entries.title: stream_with_context no longer fails inside async views
entries.migration: No code change needed; bug fix
entries.quote: `stream_with_context` does not fail inside async views.

entries.title: test client follow_redirects session state fix
entries.migration: No code change needed; bug fix
entries.quote: When using `follow_redirects` in the test client, the final state of `session` is correct.

entries.title: send_file bytes IO type hint relaxed
entries.migration: No code change needed; type hint relaxation
entries.quote: Relax type hint for passing bytes IO to `send_file`.

entries.title: session accessed marker for in/len operations
entries.migration: No code change needed; security advisory fix
entries.quote: The session is marked as accessed for operations that only access the keys but not the values, such as `in` and `len`.

entries.title: -e path precedence over .env/.flaskenv; load_dotenv defaults change
entries.migration: No code change needed; CLI behavior change
entries.quote: -e path takes precedence over default `.env` and `.flaskenv` files. `load_dotenv` loads default files in addition to a path unless `load_defaults=False` is passed.

entries.title: host_matching/subdomain_matching interaction with SERVER_NAME fixed
entries.migration: No code change needed; behavior fix
entries.quote: Fix how setting `host_matching=True` or `subdomain_matching=False` interacts with `SERVER_NAME`. Setting `SERVER_NAME` no longer restricts requests to only that domain.

entries.title: copy_current_request_context can now decorate async functions
entries.migration: No code change needed; function decorator now supports async
entries.quote: `copy_current_request_context` can decorate async functions.

entries.title: FlaskClient.open override no longer errors on redirect
entries.migration: No code change needed; behavior change for redirect handling
entries.quote: Overriding `FlaskClient.open` will not cause an error on redirect.

entries.title: flask run --exclude-patterns option added
entries.migration: No code change needed; new CLI option
entries.quote: Add an `--exclude-patterns` option to the `flask run` CLI command.

entries.title: lazy loading Click context availability in loader thread
entries.migration: No code change needed; debugger behavior change
entries.quote: When using lazy loading (the default with the debugger), the Click context from the `flask run` command remains available in the loader thread.

entries.title: session cookie deletion uses httponly flag
entries.migration: No code change needed; security behavior change
entries.quote: Deleting the session cookie uses the `httponly` flag.

entries.title: errorhandler typing relaxed; can decorate same function multiple times
entries.migration: No code change needed; typing improvement
entries.quote: Relax typing for `errorhandler` to allow the user to use more precise types and decorate the same function multiple times.

entries.title: __exit__ method typing improved for ExitStack compatibility
entries.migration: No code change needed; typing improvement
entries.quote: Fix typing for `__exit__` methods for better compatibility with `ExitStack`.

entries.title: Config.from_prefixed_env() added
entries.migration: No code change needed; new config method
entries.quote: Add `Config.from_prefixed_env()` to load config values from environment variables that start with `FLASK_` or another prefix.

entries.title: Flask.open_resource/open_instance_resource/Blueprint.open_resource encoding param added
entries.migration: No code change needed; new optional parameter defaults to utf-8
entries.quote: Flask.open_resource/Blueprint.open_resource take an `encoding` parameter to use when opening in text mode. It defaults to `utf-8`.

entries.title: Request.max_content_length per-request customization added
entries.migration: No code change needed; new config MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE and MAX_FORM_PARTS
entries.quote: `Request.max_content_length` can be customized per-request instead of only through the `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` config. Added `MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE` and `MAX_FORM_PARTS` config.

entries.title: Partitioned cookie attribute support via SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED
entries.migration: No code change needed; new config option
entries.quote: Add support for the `Partitioned` cookie attribute (CHIPS), with the `SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED` config.

entries.title: SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS config for key rotation support
entries.migration: No code change needed; new config for extensions
entries.quote: Support key rotation with the `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` config, a list of old secret keys that can still be used for unsigning.

entries.title: Request.trusted_hosts checked during routing; TRUSTED_HOSTS config added
entries.migration: No code change needed; new config option
entries.quote: `Request.trusted_hosts` is checked during routing, and can be set through the `TRUSTED_HOSTS` config.

entries.title: Provide config option to control automatic OPTIONS responses
entries.migration: No code change needed; new config option
entries.quote: Provide a configuration option to control automatic option responses.

entries.title: url_for allows self as argument
entries.migration: No code change needed; new capability
entries.quote: Allow self as an argument to url_for.
